prose: Mark Gober returns to InnerVerse to discuss one of the most baffling phenomena in existence: interactions with non-human intelligences. In his book An End to Upside Down Contact, Mark dispels the fallacies around these bizarre encounters. By considering a consciousness-first cosmology, these events make a bit more sense. Tune in to hear about breakaway navigators, alien hair samples, spiritual abductions, memory manipulation, communication with the dead, and psychopomp mythology.
ext: The ride gets wilder, with dark spirit beings, physical implants, Satanic psyche-grafting, and the interest these beings have in the human reproductive power.
